# repository blob and tree links with numbered, hyphenated file names. the sentence punctuation
# after the closing paren, `).` `):` `)?` `>.`, closes the prose, not the URL.
# a dated file name such as `2026-09-10-docs-site-redesign.md` is a slug of words and short numbers.
